displayDescription.en:
Latent Diffusion Models moved the expensive denoising process from pixel space into the compressed latent space of a pretrained autoencoder. This preserved perceptual detail while reducing the spatial and computational burden of diffusion training and sampling.

Cross-attention made the same framework conditionable on text, bounding boxes, semantic maps and other inputs. The balance of quality, flexibility and efficiency became the technical foundation for widely used systems including Stable Diffusion.
displayDescription.zh:
潜扩散模型把昂贵的去噪过程从像素空间移到预训练自编码器的压缩潜空间。这样既保留感知细节，又降低扩散训练与采样的空间尺寸和计算负担。

交叉注意力使同一框架能够接受文本、边界框、语义图等条件。质量、灵活性与效率之间的平衡，使它成为 Stable Diffusion 等广泛使用系统的技术基础。

html.en: Pixel-space diffusion models produced strong images but spent substantial computation repeatedly denoising every pixel. The latent diffusion work asked whether perceptual compression could remove redundant detail before the generative process begins.
html.zh: 像素空间扩散模型能够生成高质量图像，但反复对每个像素去噪会消耗大量算力。潜扩散研究追问：能否在生成开始前通过感知压缩去除冗余细节。

html.en: A pretrained autoencoder maps images into a lower-dimensional latent representation, where a U-Net learns the diffusion process. Cross-attention injects text or spatial conditions, and the decoder maps the denoised latent back to pixels.
html.zh: 预训练自编码器把图像映射到更低维的潜表示，U-Net 在其中学习扩散过程。交叉注意力注入文本或空间条件，解码器再把去噪后的潜表示还原为像素。

html.en: Experts generally treat latent diffusion as the efficiency breakthrough that made high-quality text-to-image generation broadly deployable. Its architecture became central to Stable Diffusion and to a large ecosystem of conditioning, editing and personalization methods.
html.zh: 专家通常把潜扩散视为让高质量文生图得以广泛部署的效率突破。其架构成为 Stable Diffusion 以及大量条件控制、编辑和个性化方法的核心。
